history.prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a modular mechanical assembly resting on a brushed steel desk in a control room. The assembly consists of a thick, solid slate grey perimeter housing enclosing a weathered orange internal inspection gate that is visibly unlatched and left open. Extreme asymmetry, off-centre on the right third, generous negative space on the left. Bone white and slate grey matte surfaces with moulding seams and contact shadows. One directional key light from the left throwing long cast shadows across the textured steel surface. No bare shapes, no text, no molded lettering.
